name: Emdash
long_description:
Emdash brings Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents into one app.

Run agents in parallel on your own infrastructure, Emdash Cloud or locally. Start tasks from Slack, Linear or GitHub, and let agents keep working after you close your laptop. Access sessions from web, desktop or mobile.

Share environments, skills, MCP servers and secrets across your team, with centralized access and spend controls. Bring your existing AI subscriptions and cloud commitments. No lock-in.
one_liner: One app for all your coding agents
